metas.name: Epic - First Semester
metas.description: Far from home, Aditya wrestles with family expectations, cultural differences and loneliness while studying in London – until he meets the lively Kadali.

metas.name: Irumudi
metas.description: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

metas.name: Romanchakam
metas.description: An entrepreneur hoping to make money off romance ends up falling in love. But when she blocks him on social media, he tries to reignite their spark.

metas.name: Maa Inti Bangaram
metas.description: Through both her moments of fear and bravery, a woman discovers that embracing her vulnerabilities is as vital to her inner strength as facing challenges head-on.

metas.name: Aham Brahmasmi?
metas.description: After his faith is shattered by the senseless murder of a starving child, a disillusioned devotee sets out to find the ending to a cryptic childhood story, ultimately discovering that the divine savior he has been searching for is actually closer than he thinks.

metas.name: Ramba Oorvasi Menaka
metas.description: A man spends 15 years attempting to use a magical book to summon the celestial angels Ramba, Urvasi, and Menaka to earth, but Lord Indra blocks their descent until they finally arrive.

metas.name: Karmakhya
metas.description: A mysterious visit to a grieving family pulls a young woman into a terrifying world of secrets, black magic, and haunting illusions. As disturbing events begin to blur the line between reality and nightmare, Kaamakhya finds herself trapped in a chilling chain of events rooted in a dark past that refuses to stay buried.

metas.name: Vadala
metas.description: A seemingly perfect couple's life takes an unsettling turn when an unexpected presence enters their world. What begins as admiration slowly spirals into emotional chaos, blurring the lines between love, attachment, and obsession.

metas.name: Maremma
metas.description: In a village bound by ancient traditions, the Maremma Goddess festival is a time of both reverence and fear. Every 12 years, a male bull is sacrificed to the deity, yet with each ceremony, calamity befalls the villagers. Despite their efforts, the elders fail to prevent disaster. Determined to break the cycle, they enact a new decree: any household whose bull bears a male calf in the next 100 days must offer it to the goddess. As the deadline approaches, the fate of the village hangs in the balance, and the true test of their resolve begins.

metas.name: Nagabandham: The Secret Treasure
metas.description: A chosen warrior protects a mystical, serpent-bound Himalayan temple from those seeking to steal the power of the Brahma Kamalam, a divine relic.

metas.name: Deewana
metas.description: Munna, an ordinary boy in an ordinary world, sees a beauty that feels beyond his reach. While he struggles to become worthy of her, she is quietly learning to leave.

metas.name: Lenin
metas.description: In a village trapped by generations of bloodshed, a determined young man dares to challenge the traditions fueling an endless cycle of violence.

metas.name: Mahendragiri Vaaraahi
metas.description: Siddharth, an atheist and skeptic, is drawn into a mysterious journey surrounding the ancient Varahi temple at Mahendragiri. As he uncovers secrets connected to the sacred site, he is forced to confront forces beyond his understanding, challenging his beliefs and changing his perception of faith, destiny, and the supernatural.

metas.name: Chennai Love Story
metas.description: Two young people navigate their first experience of love, dealing with its powerful emotions and obstacles while discovering the delicate nature of newfound romance.

metas.name: Agadha
metas.description: A solitary girl encounters a towering twelve-handed mystical idol in a torch lit shadowy cave, creating an atmosphere of spirituality and dark intrigue.

metas.name: Korean Kanakaraju
metas.description: Possessed by a Korean spirit, Kanakaraju must navigate his new supernatural identity to protect his family and solve the spirit's murder.

metas.name: Harudu
metas.description: A thrilling and intense story. A righteous protagonist (DCP Shankar), a cruel antagonist (Varadharaj), a group of unsuspecting thieves who get entangled in a murder case, and the complex web of corruption, revenge, and justice.

metas.name: Newton's 3rd Law
metas.description: Follows an investigation into a double murder in 1999, with unexpected characters roped into the case as they search for justice amid intrigue and secrets.

metas.name: Srinivasa Mangapuram
metas.description: Vasu Babu and Manga are living in their own blissful world, until a ruthless threat targets their romance. As powerful enemies move to separate them, Vasu must fight for his woman.

metas.name: Police Complaint
metas.description: A pregnant woman's murder in a suspected black magic ritual leads an officer to reopen a cold case. As those connected to the crime die mysteriously, the probe reveals a disturbing network of superstition, corruption, and secrets.

metas.name: Rao Bahadur
metas.description: Plagued by guilt and fear, an eccentric aristocrat retreats into his ancestral manor, creating an alternate world that deeply blurs reality and imagination.

metas.name: Mister Middle Class
metas.description: A middle-class man's carefully balanced life is turned upside down by unexpected challenges that test his dreams, relationships, and resilience. As he faces one setback after another, he discovers the true meaning of family, perseverance, and self-worth.

metas.name: M.R.P (Neekentha Naakentha)
metas.description: Three roommates borrow money from a dangerous lender to start a business. When their plan fails, they face serious consequences. Caught in a risky situation, they must use their wits to survive and fix their mistakes.

metas.name: Transfer Trimurthulu
metas.description: Fearless cop Trimurthulu's chance find drags him into a web of conspiracy. Standing alone against influential enemies who will stop at nothing, he risks everything to expose the truth and deliver justice.

metas.name: Hushar Pittalu
metas.description: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

metas.name: Forest Guard
metas.description: A secret reunion deep in the forest takes a dangerous turn when hidden agendas and betrayal turn Mithun's night into a fight for survival. But who can he really trust?

metas.name: Gedelaraju Kakinada Taluka
metas.description: A feared rowdy-turned-politician, Gedela Raju, is murdered on the night of his political rise in Kakinada. As the investigation unfolds, seven interconnected lives-driven by secrets, ambition, and betrayal-lead back to one shocking truth behind his death.

metas.name: Pallaburusu
metas.description: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

metas.name: KJQ
metas.description: Two close friends become entangled in a high-stakes conflict driven by power, ego, and vengeance, exploring how circumstances shape human nature.

metas.name: Oh..! Sukumari
metas.description: Follows an aspiring politician who falls in love with Sukumari, a beautiful and soft-natured woman, while her father conceals a secret that threatens their relationship.
